definitions.explanation: The very best or most outstanding within a particular group or category. Always used with a preceding scope (e.g., 日本随一 — the best in Japan).

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{社内|しゃない}→社内：13731_shanai⟧{随一|ずいいち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{営業|えいぎょう}マン→営業マン：08749_eigyouman⟧だ。
examples.english: He is the best salesperson in the company.

examples.japanese: ⟦ここ→ここ：00961_koko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧{随一|ずいいち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{温泉地|おんせんち}→温泉地：28309_onsenchi⟧だ。
examples.english: This is Japan's foremost hot spring resort area.

examples.japanese: ⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧{随一|ずいいち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{技術力|ぎじゅつりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{誇|ほこ}る→誇る：14180_hokoru⟧⟦メーカー→メーカー：11158_meekaa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{成長|せいちょう}→成長：03290_seichou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: It has grown into a manufacturer that boasts the world's foremost technological capabilities.

notes:
Compound of {随|ずい} (follow/accompany) + ⟦{一|いち}→一：00705_ichi⟧ (number one). Always preceded by a scope that specifies the group being compared.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧{随一|ずいいち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧～ (Japan's foremost ~)
- ⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧{随一|ずいいち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧～ (the world's foremost ~)
- ⟦{社内|しゃない}→社内：13731_shanai⟧{随一|ずいいち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧～ (the company's best ~)
- ⟦{業界|ぎょうかい}→業界：13129_gyoukai⟧{随一|ずいいち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧～ (the industry's foremost ~)

USAGE:
A formal expression of superlative praise. More literary and elevated than ⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧. Cannot be used without a preceding group or category — you cannot say just {随一|ずいいち} alone.
